## Alis — Reactive

### ComponentRef<T>

Typed reference to a component instance on the page.
            Returned by p.Component<T>(). Vendor-specific extensions add
            mutation methods (SetValue, Show, Focus, etc.) that emit
            Set/Call reactions on the component's source.

```csharp
EmitCall()
EmitSet()
```

### ComponentRegistration

Immutable registration of a component in the reactive plan.
            Populated at view render time by each vertical slice's HtmlExtensions.
            Consumed by gather (HTTP serialization) and validation (field enrichment).

```csharp
// Properties
BindingPath { get; }  // Model property path (e.g., "AdmissionDate", "Address.Street") — key in ComponentsMap.
ComponentId { get; }  // DOM element ID generated by IdGenerator from the model expression.
ComponentType { get; }  // Semantic component kind (e.g., "datepicker", "numerictextbox").
Shape { get; }  // Shape inferred from typeof(TProp) at registration time.             Flows to plan JSON — consumed by gather (serialization) and validation (field enrichment).
ValueMember { get; }  // Dot-path from vendor root to the readable value (e.g., "value", "checked").
Vendor { get; }  // "native" or "fusion" — determines resolution strategy at runtime.
```

### ExpressionPathHelper

Converts lambda expressions like `x => x.Address.City` into camelCase
            dot-paths for use as source bindings in the plan.

```csharp
ToElementId<T>(expression)
ToElementId<T>(expression)
ToEventPath<T>(expression)
ToEventPath<T>(expression)
ToPath<T>(prefix, expression)
ToPath<T>(prefix, expression)
ToPropertyName<T>(expression)
ToResponsePath<T>(expression)
```

### IAppLevelComponent

Marker for app-level components with a well-known element ID.

### IComponent

Base interface for all reactive components (Fusion SF, Native DOM).
            Every component declares its vendor ("native" or "fusion") as an instance property.

### IdGenerator

Generates collision-free HTML element IDs from model type and property expression.

```csharp
For(modelType, propertyPath)
For<T>(expression)
For<T>(expression)
TypeScope(type)
```

### IInputComponent

Interface for input components — provides the member name for reading the component's value.
            Used by gather and validation extensions.

```csharp
// Properties
ValueMember { get; }  // The member name on the JS object for reading the component's value.             Examples: "value", "checked"
```

### ReactivePlan<T>

Collects reactive behavior for a view: triggers, reactions, and component registrations.
            Renders the collected behavior as a Plan document for browser execution.

```csharp
// Properties
IsPartial { get; }  // Gets whether this plan represents a partial view that merges into a parent plan.
PlanId { get; }  // Gets the unique plan identifier, derived from the model type's full name.
```

```csharp
Render()
RenderFormatted()
WalkRequestReactions()
```

### ReactivePlanConfig

One-time startup configuration for the reactive framework.

```csharp
// Properties

```

```csharp

```

### ResponseBody<T>

Provides typed access to HTTP response payload properties in success and error handlers.

```csharp
Read<T>(expression)
```

### TypedEvent<T>

Typed event reference for component .Reactive() extensions.
            Holds the JS event name and provides compile-time type safety for event args.

## Builders

### IReactionEmitter

Narrow interface for emitting reactions into a pipeline.
            Used by vendor-specific extensions (Fusion, Native) and ComponentRef.

## Builders — Conditions

### EventArgSource<T>

A typed source that reads from the event payload.
            Delegates to `PayloadTypedSource<T>` with event scope.

### PayloadTypedSource<T>

A typed source that reads from any payload scope (event, success, error, dispatch).
            Generalizes event, response, and error payload reads into a single TypedSource.

### TypedComponentSource<T>

A typed source that reads the current value of a component in the browser.
            Returned by each component's Value() extension method.

### TypedSource<T>

Preserves the property type through the condition and mutation pipeline
            for compile-time type safety.

```csharp
// Properties
ElementShape { get; }  // Element shape for array types (e.g., Shape.String for string[]).
ReadMember { get; }  // The member name to read on the resolved source.
Shape { get; }  // Shape inferred from TProp.
```

```csharp
ToComponentSource()
ToValueProducer()
```

## InputField

### InputBoundFieldBase<T>

Framework-agnostic base for a model-bound input field.

## PlanModel

### CompareOp

String constants for all compare-condition operators.
            Prevents typos when building conditions — callers use
            `CompareOp.Eq` instead of the magic string `"eq"`.
            The `Shape)` parameter type stays `string`
            (serializes directly) but all internal callers use these constants.

### EventField

A value read from the triggering event's payload.
            Replaces the "$event:" magic-string prefix.

### PathJsonConverter

Serializes Path as a bare JSON array of PathSegments.
            Schema expects: [{ "kind": "property", "name": "value" }]

### PlanBuildContext

Manages JsType and Component registration during plan construction.
            Replaces the old PlanAuthoringContext triple-indirection (contracts/objects/bindings).
            Each component gets its own JsType. Members are added on-demand as builders reference them.

```csharp
EnsureComponent()
EnsureElement()
EnsureEvent()
EnsureInputComponent()
EnsureMethod()
EnsureProperty()
GetRegisteredComponents()
RegisterInputComponents()
TryFindRegistrationById()
```

### Shape

The type contract the plan expresses. Declares what a value IS and enables
            Shape-to-Shape conversion. One shared type used everywhere: JsType properties,
            ValueProducer reads, conditions, validation rules, gather.

### ShapeCompat

Picks the most specific compatible shape from two registrations.
            Returns null if incompatible (true conflict).

### StaticField

A literal key/value pair included in a gather request.
            Replaces the "$static:" magic-string prefix.

## Validation

### FieldAll

Logical AND — all terms must be true.

```csharp
// Properties
Terms { get; }  // Gets the child conditions that must all be true.
```

### FieldAny

Logical OR — any term must be true.

```csharp
// Properties
Terms { get; }  // Gets the child conditions where at least one must be true.
```

### FieldCompare

A single field comparison: read field, apply operator, compare to optional value.

```csharp
// Properties
Field { get; }  // Property name to check (e.g. "IsEmployed").
Op { get; }  // Operator from `CompareOp`.
Value { get; }  // Comparison value (null for unary operators like truthy/falsy).
```

### FieldCondition

A symbolic condition tree built at extraction time using field NAMES.
            Resolved to `Condition` at render time when
            the component map is available.

### FieldNot

Logical NOT — inverts the inner term.

```csharp
// Properties
Term { get; }  // Gets the inner condition to negate.
```

### IValidationExtractor

Extracts client-side validation rules from a validator type.
            Implemented by FluentValidationAdapter.

### ValidationField

Describes a single field's validation rules within a form.
            Enriched at render time from ComponentsMap.

### ValidationRule

A single validation rule extracted from FluentValidation.

## Fusion — AppLevel

### FusionConfirm

App-level confirm dialog backed by Syncfusion Dialog.
             Singleton per page — one SF Dialog instance serves all confirm condition evaluations.
            
             Implements IAppLevelComponent so it can be resolved without an explicit ID:
               p.Component<FusionConfirm>().Show()

### FusionToast

App-level toast notification backed by Syncfusion Toast.
             Singleton per page — one SF Toast instance serves all notifications.
            
             Implements IAppLevelComponent so it can be resolved without an explicit ID:
               p.Component<FusionToast>().SetContent("Saved").Success().Show()

### ToastPosition

Maps to Syncfusion Toast position { X, Y } values.

### ToastType

Maps to Syncfusion Toast cssClass values.

## Fusion — Components

### FusionAccordion

FusionAccordion — non-input container component.
            Has events and methods but no form value (no ValueMember, no IInputComponent).

### FusionAccordionBuilder<T>

Wraps SF AccordionBuilder.Render() output + carries plan and elementId
            for .Reactive() chaining. Non-input component — no ComponentsMap registration.

### FusionAccordionEvents

Events available on FusionAccordion.
            Singleton instance — used with .Reactive() event selector lambda:
              .Reactive(evt => evt.Expanded, (args, p) => { ... })

```csharp
// Properties
Expanded { get; }  // Fires after a panel expands or collapses (SF "expanded" event).
```

### FusionAccordionExpandedArgs

Payload for FusionAccordion.Expanded (SF "expanded" event).
            Fires after a panel expands or collapses.
            Properties are typed markers for expression-based condition sources:
              p.When(args, x => x.IsExpanded).Truthy()
            ExpressionPathHelper resolves x => x.IsExpanded to "evt.isExpanded".

```csharp
// Properties
Index { get; }  // The zero-based index of the panel that was expanded/collapsed.
IsExpanded { get; }  // True if the panel was expanded, false if collapsed.
```

## Native — Components

### NativeButton

Native HTML <button> element.
            Phantom type — constrains which vertical slice extensions are available.
            Not an IInputComponent — buttons have no form value to read.

### NativeButtonBuilder<T>

Renders a native HTML <button> element with an explicit id.
             Not model-bound — buttons don't carry data.
            
             Usage:
               @Html.NativeButton("save-btn", "Save")
                   .CssClass("rounded-md bg-accent px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white")
                   .Reactive(plan, evt => evt.Click, (args, p) =>
                   {
                       p.Post("/api/save", g => g.Static("name", "John"))
                        .Response(r => r.OnSuccess(s => ...));
                   })
            
             .Reactive() is always the last call — native builders are IHtmlContent
             directly (no .Render() needed).

```csharp
// Properties
ElementId { get; }  // The element ID — used by .Reactive() to wire events.
```

```csharp
CssClass()
Type()
```

### NativeButtonClickArgs

Payload for NativeButton.Click (DOM "click" event).
            Button clicks carry no data payload — this class is an empty marker
            used by the generic inference chain in .Reactive().

### NativeButtonEvents

Events available on NativeButton.
            Singleton instance — used with .Reactive() event selector lambda:
              .Reactive(plan, evt => evt.Click, (args, p) => { ... })

```csharp
// Properties
Click { get; }  // Fires when the user clicks the button (DOM "click" event).
```

### NativeButtonHtmlExtensions

Factory extension for creating NativeButtonBuilder.

```csharp
NativeButton<T>()
```

### NativeButtonReactiveExtensions

Wires reactive event pipelines onto the NativeButtonBuilder.
            
             Usage (in .cshtml):
               @Html.NativeButton("save-btn", "Save")
                   .CssClass("...")
                   .Reactive(plan, evt => evt.Click, (args, p) =>
                   {
                       p.Post("/api/save", g => g.Static("name", "John"))
                        .Response(r => r.OnSuccess(s => s.Element("result").SetText("Saved!")));
                   })
            
             .Reactive() is always the last call -- the builder implements IHtmlContent.
